storage_policies.check:
((bucket_id = 'exercise-visual-drafts'::text) AND public.is_superadmin() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.exercise_visual_assets a
     JOIN public.exercise_visual_sets s ON ((s.id = a.visual_set_id)))
  WHERE ((a.storage_bucket = 'exercise-visual-drafts'::text) AND (a.storage_path = objects.name) AND (s.status = 'allocated'::text) AND (s.created_by = auth.uid()) AND (s.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))))))

((bucket_id = 'profile-avatars'::text) AND ( SELECT COALESCE(public.has_app_access(), false) AS "coalesce") AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.profile_avatar_media m
  WHERE ((m.storage_path = objects.name) AND (m.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (m.state = 'allocated'::text) AND (m.created_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))))))

storage_policies.name: status_photos_insert
storage_policies.check:
((bucket_id = 'status-photos'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.statuses s
  WHERE ((s.photo_path = ('statusPhotos/'::text || objects.name)) AND (s.author_id = auth.uid()) AND (s.created_at > (now() - '00:10:00'::interval))))))

storage_policies.name: status_photos_read
storage_policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'status-photos'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.statuses s
  WHERE ((s.photo_path = ANY (ARRAY[objects.name, ('statusPhotos/'::text || objects.name)])) AND ((s.expires_at IS NULL) OR (s.retention_mode = 'no_auto_expiration'::text) OR (GREATEST(s.expires_at, private.status_promotion_until(s.*)) > now())) AND public.is_community_member(s.community_id)))))
